Comments (English): [ It's ok ] || ---------------- || Was highly rated in research, which is why I bought this model. Pros: VERY quiet. Despite the light the shines on the floor to tell you it's stage, I still have to put a rag over the bar to let my sons know it actually on, or they will open it while it's running. Cleans and dries very well. Pretty much anything you can get in there it will handle. Cons: Top "silverware" rack is more in the way than anything. With it in, you lose a lot of room in the normal top rack. Didn't take me long to just remove it. The racks themselves are poor design. Plates go in ok, but trying to get bowls or glasses in is a task. Mostly you just end up laying them where you can get them. There is an odor while running. Not an old food smell, or even a burning smell. Almost a chemical smell. Other reviews report this as common. Some say it goes away, other it doesn't. For a long time, I though my washer was burning itself up or something. 2 months, still has the smell. Very annoying. In the end, the racks I can deal with because of the pros. The smell has me wanting to replace it already at times.

Sentence (English): I love my Bosch dishwasher in every way except for 2 things.
Comments (English): [ Bottom Rack Structural issues ] || ---------------- || I love my Bosch dishwasher in every way except for 2 things. I am not crazy about being held hostage for having to purchase Finish for the life of my dishwasher. I am also hugely disappointed in the design and structure of the bottom rack. It is the most load bearing of the three as plates only fit in that rack. The rollers, which are snapped onto the bottom of the rack are not enough (3 on one side and 4 on the other) to stabilize the rack with any appreciable amount of plates which cause the rack and rollers to bow and collapse from the molded stainless steel runner ledges. The interior and door's stainless lining is of an inadequate gauge and has bent from the rack collapsing. I think there needs to be more rollers and a betterm more substantial design to accomodate heavier items such as plates. As is, I can only load half or less than the number of slots for plates.

Sentence (English): I've been using it for two weeks and I'm impressed.
Comments (English): [ Works better than expected ] || ---------------- || I've been using it for two weeks and I'm impressed. I've washed a casserole dish with oven-baked food that I didn't pre-clean. I truly didn't expect it to come out pristine. I'm also happy with how much the dishwasher holds and that even my large dishes fit well. I do have trouble with large items like pots etc. so sometimes I have to run an additional load. One negative, it's definitely louder than my very old Kenmore Elite dishwasher during one stage of cleaning, but within acceptable limits. After reading all the negative reviews about problems with installation I was most fearful of a nightmare installation. I didn't have the smoothest installation but I was extremely pleased with the installer. First the turn off valve needed to be replaced because mine was so old and blocked with crud. Unfortunately the plumber didn't have one with him as he didn't take his truck with supplies - he had a pick up truck to deliver the dishwasher. He left the dishwasher in my garage and promised to be back at 10 am the next day. And he was, with all his plumbing supplies. Changed the valve and showed me all the building up in the old one - it clearly needed to be replaced. Yes I paid $25, a reasonable fee. When he went to hook up to the electricity because the circuit breaker kept flipping off. I had to call an electrician to fix the circuit. If he had hooked up the dishwasher without the repair, the machine would have been damaged so he was very careful. He came the next day and finished the install. He did not ask for additional pay for having to come three times. We did give him a tip because that travel time was both gas and unpaid time. Sentence (English): I've been using my kitchenaid dishwasher approaching three years now and I've been very happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Kitchenaid stainless dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I've been using my kitchenaid dishwasher approaching three years now and I've been very happy with it. It is a workhorse. I've got a family of five and will sometimes have two loads a day. The dishes always come out clean and dry. I love the large removable basket for the silverware, the top third drawer has just enough clearance for beverage lids, large spoons, spatulas, etc. The middle basket still has lots of room for tall glasses and large pots. It's also much quieter than I need. To top it off, it is beautiful and fingerprint resistant. I opted for the front recessed panel, it's on an angle so when someone leans up against it, they won't be pushing buttons. The cons. well I just noticed that I am developing a small rust spot on the front, right above the vent, where the wet heat comes out. I assume it is only going to grow in size. Also, something about how low the door is when it is completely open, I cannot tell you how many times I have hit the top of my foot (bone) against the corner (which has no give) wondering each time if I broke bone. I never did this with my old dishwasher, I believe the old one was higher as it was much older. Because of the two cons, 4.5 stars but I would buy it again.

It dries well enough. Where we're a little confused is the racks, especially the second, top rack where we put glasses and bowls. There doesn't seem to be any way to position glasses so they won't bump against each other every time you pull the rack out and in. It's like the wild west up there, unlike our old one of a different brand which had spines in the right places and kept everything orderly. The bottom rack spines are very close together which worried me at first, but the dishes come out clean anyway so maybe that just saves a ton of space. So I'm docking a star for that strange second rack, unless someone can show me a system that I'm missing. But for cleaning and shine, I doubt you can beat this machine.

It was very easy to connect it online with the Smart HQ app which is also convenient to manage your dishwasher directly from your phone, it helps with ordering detergent and keeping an eye on your use of it and maintenance needs. Sentence (English): The previous dishwasher was made by Bosch and lasted 19 years, so the choice was easy in terms of the manufacturer.
Comments (English): [ Quiet dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The previous dishwasher was made by Bosch and lasted 19 years, so the choice was easy in terms of the manufacturer. However, the choice of the model was difficult due to the different options of the individual models. I wanted it to be quiet and indeed the dishwasher is quiet. After a few washes I can say that the cutlery drawer works better than the basket. Setting the dishwasher via the app is convenient. In the previous dishwasher, I could put both plates and pots in the lower basket in the second row - here either the entire row of plates or pots. The dishes are dry, I hope that the zeolith technology will work until the end of the dishwasher's days.
Comments (Original): [ Cicha zmywarka ] || ---------------- || Poprzednia zmywarka była firmy Bosch i przeżyła 19 lat, więc wybór był prosty jeżeli chodzi o producenta. Jednak wybór modelu był trudny ze względu na różne opcje poszczególnych modeli. Zależało mi na cichość pracy i faktycznie zmywarka jest cichutka. Po kilku zmywaniach mogę stwierdzić, że szuflada na sztućce się sprawdza lepiej niż koszyk. Ustawianie zmywarki przez aplikację jest wygodne. W poprzedniej zmywarce w dolnym koszu w drugim rzędzie mogłem umieścić zarówno talerze i garnki - tutaj albo cały rząd talerzy, albo garnki. Naczynia są suche, mam nadzieję, że technologia zeolith będzie działać do końca dni zmywarki.

Sentence (English): I bought this about two months ago and installed it myself.

There is an online video that explains everything really well, however, there is one glitch. A drip tray has to be removed and a wire connection disconnected. Mine would not release and in using a pair of long nose pliers I broke the tab and had to come up with a way to secure it on assembly. Very bad design! Installation went well but the instructions and video tell you to refit the drip tray AFTER the machine has been fitted under the countertop. Why? Can't imagine what the state of the tableware and utensils must be like to need a Normal or higher wash cycle. This thing is a very high temperature pressure washer, and we love it!

Sentence (English): We bought this unit to replace a 7-year old GE Adora model after 3 control panel failures.
Comments (English): [ Very, very disappointed in this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We bought this unit to replace a 7-year old GE Adora model after 3 control panel failures. I thought the old one was bad, and now I'm wishing I had replaced the control panel in it again rather than buying this new piece of junk. In fact, I would return it if I could. The new racks are flimsy, the bottom rack tines are not adjustable, and the upper rack arm mechanism is made out of the thinnest metal I have ever seen. The new silverware basket does not separate into sections like the old one and it too is very flimsy. I actually put the old bottom rack in the new dishwasher so I wouldn't have to deal with the wheels falling off the new bottom rack, a flaw that even the salesman at the store mentioned. The old bottom rack has the adjustable tines and some weight to it, with sturdy wheel mechanisms. The new unit did not come with an insulation blanket so I took the old one off and used it. The front door feels like raising and lowering a piece of cardboard, the exterior metal feels like an aluminum can, and the unit is not very quiet. The handle does not match the older GE product handles, and the GE logo on the front is different, although I wish those metal things weren't there at all. The interior of the dishwasher does not get dry unless you run it on the extended boost setting which extends the run time for one hour. (One should not have to run a half load of dishes for 4 hours to get everything dry.) The chime denoting the completion of the cycle is also way too loud, although I have not tried muting the sounds yet to see if that will shut it up. The piece de resistance is the hateful indicator light. The first night we ran the dishwasher, we went to bed. My husband woke up in the night because it was so bright, it was like the Star of Bethlehem. It illuminates our entire kitchen. I tried to cover it with a Sharpie to dim it but it is still too too much. This remains to be resolved. I doubt that this unit will last beyond the extended warranty period - and this is the first time I have ever purchased an extended warranty because I have no confidence that we will have a product that doesn't fail in some way. Its only redeeming feature is that the control buttons are not recessed like the old one. We bought this brand again because we have the slate gray color and they are the only company that makes it. I don't understand why we can't make quality products in this country that last more than a few years, like we used to get here. GE, I really think you can do better.

Bosch, not everything needs an app, and not everything needs to be connected to my wifi, especially when I lose the ability to more-quickly run a cycle when I'm at home (98% of the time I am ever going to run my dishwasher). Really frustrating.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is fantastic from an actual cleaning standpoint as well as the low noise level which was the whole reason we replaced our old FA unit.
Comments (English): The dishwasher is fantastic from an actual cleaning standpoint as well as the low noise level which was the whole reason we replaced our old FA unit. The only thing I'm not so fond of is the almost need for the connect app to get to all of the useful features like delayed starts or really personalized cycles. While the unit uses very little water overall, it's interesting to me how long the unit runs on any cycle with a dry, even the door open dry which is a great feature for plastics. The tab counter is nice as well in the app and the inside space of the dishwasher is so much more useful with the third rack feature than our old dishwasher was. My only other complaint isn't about the unit but the HD team that installed it - well, they delivered it, and half installed it but I had to get involved and help finish the job after they destroyed the top vanity plate because the screws were too long to be used above into a granite counter above rather than on the sizes as directed. Additionally the team had no clue how to install the toe kick and were told on the phone by their supervisor to “just drill anywhere into the plastic down there, it won't matter” - thankfully I was there to overhear this and take charge but not before the toe kick was scratched all over. Under no circumstances did these guys plan to open a manual as “all dishwashers are the same.” While Bosch replaced my toe kick, I'm still left with a top vanity panel that has two screw gouges due to the Home Depot install team - this is the only reason for a lower rating; the product is fantastic and hopefully it lasts while looking great like our matching Bosch refrigerator.

Sentence (English): Costco installer over tightened water input pipe and broke it.
Comments (English): [ Horrible Experience - SF Bay Area Customers aware ] || ---------------- || Costco installer over tightened water input pipe and broke it. As a result dishwasher was leaking. It created mess in under sink and our kitchen. Costco took another 2 weeks to get replacement dishwasher. For both installations and de-installation it took enormous amount of time, phone calls and emails. We paid $100 more than market to buy from Costco and get free installation however installer charged additional $125 for replacing input valve which they told it was broken despite old dishwasher used it without any problems. Both times installer came with drying towels and shoe covers. We had to clean kitchen thrice during this mess. Advise for SF Bay Area customers to get cash for installation and do it with your local handyman or do not buy from Costco. Costco's installer (MasterPro or Mastpro) has very bad reviews on Yelp. We wish would have known before hand. We called to Costco Warehouse Logistics to give feedback and their response was we don't have any other way - we can replace or return - period. We expected Costco level experience however, regrettably it was not the case.

Sentence (English): Pluses - it's quiet and the dishes come out clean.
Comments (English): [ OK, not great. A good value though. ] || ---------------- || Pluses - it's quiet and the dishes come out clean. Minuses - flimsy, no quick rinse cycle, racks are very thin, hard to change upper rack height, controls are sensitive and flimsy. Items in the top rack fall over unless you pull open and push close carefully. The manual does not include most of the options. For that you need to go to an online manual. That online manual has mistakes - for example, it shows the wrong key sequence to turn the chimes on and off. The racks are made of very thin rubber-coated wire. I don't imagine these will last long once they receive the inevitable nick. The machine is very very light and the door feels flimsy. The stainless steel on the interior is very thin. There is no quick wash or quick rinse cycle. The upper rack is height adjustable but has no lever or button like many other machines. You have to slide the rack all the way out of one track and put it into another. The controls can be activated just by brushing up near the machine. I find I have to set the Ctrl-Lock both when it's running and when it's off to avoid stopping or starting it by accident. Some people have complained about the flatware rack being in the back. Had they read the manual they would have seen that the rack was placed there for shipping only - it should be removed and relocated to the right-hand side for use. I paid $450 for this dishwasher including shipping. I think it's a good value for that money but if I had to do it again I'd spend a little buy a higher-quality machine. Overall I give it an 'OK'. I do not expect this machine to come close to the 18 years my outgoing Whirlpool lasted but am hoping to be surprised. Of course, I spent about the same amount of money on that machine 18 years ago as this one costs today.

Had they read the manual they would have seen that the rack was placed there for shipping only - it should be removed and relocated to the right-hand side for use.I paid $450 for this dishwasher including shipping. I think it's a good value for that money but if I had to do it again I'd spend a little buy a higher-quality machine. Overall I give it an 'OK'.I do not expect this machine to come close to the 18 years my outgoing Whirlpool lasted but am hoping to be surprised. Of course, I spent about the same amount of money on that machine 18 years ago as this one costs today.

Sentence (English): I thought it was only for houses with kids.
Comments (English): [ I thought it was only for houses with kids. ] || ---------------- || I thought it was only for houses with kids. As the two of us lived together, I wondered if it would be useful, but it would have been unfair if we had lived without knowing;; As a dual-income couple who came home late from work, I kept getting behind on housework, and I can see why my friends recommended it. There are many brands, but I used the LG dishwasher. There were different sizes for 6 people and 12 people, but they recommended 14 people because they said it wouldn't take too much. Since this is my first time using it, is it a baseboard? I didn't even know that, but the height of the baseboard in my house was 15cm. The LG is the only one that comes in at 15cm, so I'm happy that it fits in like a custom fit without having to cut it. I thought it was too big, but no, even if there are two of us, we'll have to use it for 14 people. Four frying pans fit at the bottom of the gel. The driver said I didn't need to wash it first, so I just put it in, and it was amazing that even the stuck meat was washed away. Another advantage of LG is that it has a function that allows you to rinse thoroughly by adding water and salt! When I used it, it took only 40 minutes of automatic + rinse twice + hot air to remove all the slightest stains without leaving any stains. If you want to sterilize by boiling water, you can add steam. My husband likes it more than me, so he does all the dishes. You can run it quietly even in the evening. I hope dual-income couples like us who get off work late can get into a coma with this.

Comments (English): I've been using a dishwasher for a long time, and it's incredibly convenient. So, I've been promoting it to people around me, urging them to buy one. I especially recommend LG products. I used to use a premium line dishwasher from Company S, but it broke and I got a refund. I'm currently using an LG Dios, and I'm very happy with it. These days, the Objet d'Or has a beautiful color and even better features, but it's much cheaper. This one, even with the latest specifications, is much cheaper than other sites, so I bought it for my mother. Actually, I had to remodel my mother's sink, so I scheduled the installation for a week later. The price had dropped by about 50,000 won, so I considered canceling and repurchasing. However, when I tried to repurchase, the installation date was set for the 23rd, which is more than two weeks later. I thought I'd get the benefit of using it a little sooner, so I went ahead and bought it. It's not cheap, but it's a shame the price fluctuated so much in such a short period of time. Anyway, I'm satisfied, as the installer was very helpful and provided thorough advice. I was worried my mom might have trouble learning how to use the detergent, so I bought all the detergent in advance and sent it to her. I always use a pinch of salt to prevent water stains, so I sent her some salt, too. She said she didn't need a water softener, so she told me to use it later after using the dishwasher, and just showed me how to use it. Next time I replace my dishwasher, I'll have to buy it from Coupang. If you time it right, you can get a really great deal.
Comments (Original): 제가 식기세척기를 오랫동안 쓰고있는데 너무너무 편하거든요.그래서 주변에 사라고 사라고 홍보를 많이 했어요.그중에서도 엘지 제품을 추천하는 편인데...원래 저는 S사의 프리미엄 라인 식세기를 쓰다가 고장이 나서 환불받고엘지 디오스를 쓰고있는데, 이것도 너무너무 만족하면서 쓰고있는데,요즘은 오브제로 색상도 예쁘고 기능도 더 좋은데 그때보다 훨씬 저렴한 가격으로 판매하고있네요 ㅎㅎ이 제품도 최신 사양인데도 다른 사이트보다 훨씬 저렴하게 판매를 해서 친정 어머니 사용하시라고 구입해드렸어요.사실 친정 싱크대 리모델링 일정하고 맞춰야해서 설치 일정을 일주일후로 잡아놨는데, 그 사이에 가격이 5만원 정도 내려서 취소후 재구매를 할까도 고민했는데ㅠㅠ재구매하려고보니 설치일이 23일 이후로 되어있어서 2주이상 차이나니조금더 빨리 쓰는 값이라고 생각하자 싶어 그냥 구매는 했으나,짧은 기간에 적은 돈이 아닌데 가격변동이 심한적은 아쉽습니다.어쨌든 설치기사님도 친절하게 잘 알려주셨다고 하니 만족합니다.혹시 세제넣고 쓰는 법을 엄마가 어려워하지않을까 싶어세제도 미리 다 사서 보내두었거든요.저는 물때때문에 한주소금을 꼭 쓰고있는편이라서 소금도 보내두었는데,연수장치를 쓸정도가 아니라고 나중에 식세기쓰다가 사용하라며 사용법만 알려주셨다고 해요.저도 다음에 식세기 교체할때는 쿠팡으로 구입해야겠어요.타이밍만 잘 맞추면 정말 초핫딜로 구매가능하네요 ㅎㅎ

Comments (English): [ Good for what I need in small space ] || ---------------- || I've had this unit since June, 2022. So far it's performed as expected and fits my tiny kitchen space. I couldn't figure out how to fix this so I use a rubber foot stopper to keep it from moving around after use. It cleans my dishes way better than I could and has enough room for sport water bottles on the top drawer with maybe two large pans and bowls on the main drawer. I still have to wash large items by hand but I don't think they would fit in a standard machine. I do wish you could adjust the height of the top drawer so it sat lower so you could put larger items up there. Thanks!

Sentence (English): I replaced a failing six-year old Whirlpool dishwasher with this Bosch 800 Series SHP78CM5N in January 2024.
Comments (English): [ Incredibly quiet dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I replaced a failing six-year old Whirlpool dishwasher with this Bosch 800 Series SHP78CM5N in January 2024. The difference is night and day! Not only is the Bosch dishwasher unbelievably quiet (the indicator light on the front may be your only indication that the machine is running), but more importantly it does a fabulous job cleaning all the dishes and cookware we place in it. We just scrape plates and pans off (as the manual recommends, no pre-rinsing) and the dishwasher tackles the dirtiest of dishes with aplomb. We've been using Finish® Powerball Quantum Dishwasher Pods - Bosch's recommended dishwasher detergent. The only issue we had was with Lowe's installation of the dishwasher. The technician did not install the toe panel properly and took all the parts that came with the dishwasher with him when he left. I figured out pretty quickly what was needed and I reached out to Bosch via the Home Connect app and they very quickly sent me the parts that I needed to correct the technician's mistake. Very impressed with not only the dishwasher but also Bosch's customer service!

Sentence (English): This is the best dishwasher we have ever had.
Comments (English): [ Amazing, and AWESOME interior design ] || ---------------- || This is the best dishwasher we have ever had. Everything always comes out clean. It is SO well designed! It has so much SPACE inside. If you are a cook who likes to use a variety of pots, bowls (and anything besides plates and regular sized items), you will really appreciate this dishwasher, as it has a ton of flexible space to put everything. Flexibility in the design with 3 racks and enough over variable head space in each rack allows for a total mix and match of how you load it. For example, little awkward sized bowls on the 3rd rack, or glasses, mugs. Or a huge pot on the bottom. I used to have to handwash a bunch because it didn't fit with my previous dishwasher, but no longer. This dishwasher is a total lifesaver for my messy cooking style! (Husband no longer complains that I dirtied every dish cooking, LOL. It all fits in the machine now). I have challenged the dishwasher skeptically, by loading it with terribly dirty pots and caked on baked items several times and expected it to fail, but it did not. I found the trick for best results on SUPER dirty items and pots is to use the "Tough" cycle, and high-temperature. I went with the recommendation to use the Cascade Platinum tabs, and I think this makes a big difference as well on just HOW sparkly everything comes out. :)We seriously looked at purchasing a Miele or a Bosch at first (came very close). But my sister insisted we consider this model as she is a big cook like me, and she has never been happier than with this dishwasher's interior configuration and design. She pointed out that the Miele has less interior space for all kinds of different sized dishes, and is more designed for European slim dishes and really not as flexible inside. And both are totally overpriced compared to what this model delivers. (Don't pay for the name - they say they last longer, but objectively you can buy 2 of these for less than an over-priced Miele.)We have had the dishwasher now for about 5 months and are very impressed. Providing the technology and dishwasher's "brain" lasts for many years, this will be one of the best appliance purchases we have ever made in 30 years.Drying is VERY good compared to other dishwashers we have owned. Naturally, if you put in a bowl (or anything with a little receptable) in upside down, you will have some pooled water. We haven't used the super pro dry cycle ever, since we prefer to save energy. Much less residual puddles on top of mugs, compared to other dishwashers. I find the trick is just to open the door a crack after it's done, things evaporate, and so I never really have to deal with that anyway. Overall, cannot say enough just how happy we are that we listened to my sister and purchased this model. I highly recommend this product, it is fantastic!

Sentence (English): I'm a newlywed, celebrating my first year of marriage, and a mother of a one-month-old.
Comments (English): I'm a newlywed, celebrating my first year of marriage, and a mother of a one-month-old. I moved into a rented apartment, and since it was a jeonse (long-term lease), I hadn't even considered buying a dishwasher. But after having a baby and moving back home, trying to manage both the baby and the housework was overwhelming. To improve my quality of life, I heard about a no-installation dishwasher and immediately purchased it! At first, I planned to use it only for bottles, but since I'm breastfeeding, I ended up using it exclusively for dishes. The installation only had two hoses: one for draining and one for sucking up water. I bought a 10-liter bucket and keep it next to me to suck up the water. You can buy a dedicated bucket on the website, but I wanted a more colorful one, so I bought one separately. It's for three people, so it can't hold much, but it's perfect for our home. It washes well. These days, I only eat seaweed soup, so I wash the oil before putting it in. Interestingly, there's a place to put detergent on the bottom. The basic wash cycle takes about an hour, and when it's done, it turns on the FAN mode and the fan spins inside. It seems to be drying. I've had it for about a week now, and it's a great product. Don't hesitate. If you need it, definitely buy it.

Sentence (English): GE's Cafe line of appliances are beautiful and we've had no problem with the range or refrigerator.
Comments (English): [ Beautiful and quiet - but.  ] || ---------------- || GE's Cafe line of appliances are beautiful and we've had no problem with the range or refrigerator. However, the jury is still out on the dishwasher. after initial instal, it ran (very quietly) for 10 minutes and then shut off and would not restart. I took the lick plate off to ensure the wire nuts on the power cord had not come loose, and found a very small puddle of water on my wooden floor directly below the drain pump. It appears the water leaked onto the power module and shorted it out. I'm more than a little put off that after removing my other (working) dishwasher and replacing it with a brand new (and rather expensive) dishwasher, that I have to wait a week for an appliance repairman to fix it. I'll assume, for now, it was an easy to fix anomaly and that I'll have no additional problems, just like the Cafe range and refrigerator. Hopefully that's the case. For what it's worth, it's so quiet that its hard to tell if its running (it actually was running before it crapped out). I'll update the review once I find out.

Comments (English): [ A very effective and quiet budget dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Bosch makes great dishwashers - this is our third one by them. This series 100 is their low end model so not all the bells and whistles. But still very quiet and cleans well. The main complaint is that there is no indicator on the outside to signal end of cycle, so you have to open the door to check then restart the cycle (some shine a light on the floor but not this one). The towel bar is nice but the towel hits the floor when opened. The door height is slightly higher than the last model we had (300 series) so we can't open an adjacent cabinet door when it is open - unique to our kitchen of course. Installation may be expensive since there may be some new procedures required if you are updating an older model - cost us $300 to install. Still, definitely recommend.

Comments (English): [ Undecided ] || ---------------- || We purchased the Bosch dishwasher due to the silverware tray and the good reputation of Bosch. It is a good looking appliance imo. And no the tray is not over crowded; We use every other holder. The other issue is the rinse liquid holder. We fill it a little bit and then close the lid but when you close the door the rinse aid flows out to the bottom of the dishwasher. The manual is not clear on whether this is normal or not. Overall, I would recommend the dishwasher but wish that the rinse aid and silverware issues could be resolved.

I give it three stars because it does a halfway decent job at cleaning, but it needs a major redesign for future models.

I used to be able to nest bowls in my old dishwasher but the bowls won’t sit that way here. Plus if you try to put bowls into the prongs it leaves a gap on one side of the next row—but too small to fit anything else into it. The rack is totally illogical. The hose is way too short and barely reaches my sink. Also, what were they thinking with the instrument panel being on top of the door? It looks lovely when you open the door, but once you close it, you lose the benefit of the countdown panel unless you squint your eye into the tiny gap between the panel and the top while the dishwasher is running. Even then it’s difficult to see. The wheels don’t turn very well either, making it hard to maneuver. I give it three stars because it does a halfway decent job at cleaning, but it needs a major redesign for future models.

Here is the story so far: It worked straight out of the box - 10/10. Straightforward installation (the instructions for adjusting height could be a bit clearer) - 9.5/10. Intuitive and easy to operate - 10/10. Features & settings (for this price point I would have expected a pre-rinse setting) - 9/10. It does the job it claims to do - 10/10. Aesthetics (plastic panels at front cheapen the appearance) - 8/10. Build quality (lower front plastic panel a bit flimsy) - 9.5/10. Value for money - 9.75/10. Noise from operation - 9.75/10. Other quibbles - the installation instructions could be a bit more helpful. The operating manual did not explain how to adjust the feet and the international "pictures only" addendum could be better. At this price point, I would have expected the product have a short pre-rinse cycle. The identification label containing the serial number could be clearer. Last thing, the "new smell" chemical odour from inside the tub - after two wash cycles - was still present. Perhaps I am being a little picky, but it is important to remember this was not the cheapest "made outside Germany" product(in this instance, Turkey) in the model lineup. Overall, I am satisfied with this dishwasher and would recommend it to others. It represents great value for money which, in my opinion, places it halfway between the gutter and the stars.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Amazing, and AWESOME interior design ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) This is the best dishwasher we have ever had. Everything always comes out clean. It is SO well designed! It has so much SPACE inside. If you are a cook who likes to use a variety of pots, bowls (and anything besides plates and regular sized items), you will really appreciate this dishwasher, as it has a ton of flexible space to put everything. Flexibility in the design with 3 racks and enough over variable head space in each rack allows for a total mix and match of how you load it. For example, little awkward sized bowls on the 3rd rack, or glasses, mugs. Or a huge pot on the bottom. I used to have to handwash a bunch because it didn't fit with my previous dishwasher, but no longer. This dishwasher is a total lifesaver for my messy cooking style! (Husband no longer complains that I dirtied every dish cooking, LOL. It all fits in the machine now). I have challenged the dishwasher skeptically, by loading it with terribly dirty pots and caked on baked items several times and expected it to fail, but it did not. I found the trick for best results on SUPER dirty items and pots is to use the "Tough" cycle, and high-temperature. I went with the recommendation to use the Cascade Platinum tabs, and I think this makes a big difference as well on just HOW sparkly everything comes out. :)We seriously looked at purchasing a Miele or a Bosch at first (came very close). But my sister insisted we consider this model as she is a big cook like me, and she has never been happier than with this dishwasher's interior configuration and design. She pointed out that the Miele has less interior space for all kinds of different sized dishes, and is more designed for European slim dishes and really not as flexible inside. And both are totally overpriced compared to what this model delivers. (Don't pay for the name - they say they last longer, but objectively you can buy 2 of these for less than an over-priced Miele.)We have had the dishwasher now for about 5 months and are very impressed. Providing the technology and dishwasher's "brain" lasts for many years, this will be one of the best appliance purchases we have ever made in 30 years.Drying is VERY good compared to other dishwashers we have owned. Naturally, if you put in a bowl (or anything with a little receptable) in upside down, you will have some pooled water. We haven't used the super pro dry cycle ever, since we prefer to save energy. Much less residual puddles on top of mugs, compared to other dishwashers. I find the trick is just to open the door a crack after it's done, things evaporate, and so I never really have to deal with that anyway. Overall, cannot say enough just how happy we are that we listened to my sister and purchased this model. I highly recommend this product, it is fantastic!

Sentence (English): The longer I have this dishwasher, the more things I discover to love.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || The longer I have this dishwasher, the more things I discover to love. The biggest thing being that it actually dries my dishes! We have lots of plastic wear the kids pack for lunches, and despite having lots of nooks and crannies, we rarely if ever have drippy lids. Our plastic cups with little dips on the bottom are not filled with water! I also love how adjustable the racks are. The plate spacers at the bottom can be made narrower or wider fairly easily. The utensil insert on the very top rack can be removed if you have larger spatulas. The capacity is almost TOO big. Even with our family of 6, we run out of dishes before it's completely full! My only note would be that it could be a bit quieter. It is quieter than my previous dishwasher, but certainly not one of those models that are so quiet, you can't even tell it is on.

The installer felt burdened by installing it without drilling holes because he thought that he would be responsible if there was a problem later. Comments (English): [ I am satisfied with the product. ] || ---------------- || I had been using an SK Magic dishwasher for 7 years at my previous home, but when I moved, I was told the installation fee would be around 40,000-50,000 won and the lifespan was only 5 years, so I looked into Samsung dishwashers. However, since I live in a rented apartment, I drew inspiration from other reviews for a drill-free installation method and connected the pipe directly along the baseboard without drilling (see photo). I am satisfied with the installation, as I used a pipe strip to minimize interference and prevent bending. The technician seemed quite hesitant about the drill-free installation, saying he would be responsible if any problems arose later. It seems the pipe bending would be almost the same whether installed like in the photo or with a drill, so it is a bit of a shame.
